items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: the spotlight man said, Judy, how are you doing it? ... he said, aren't Judy, Johnny was in the pit at the Orphian?

ctx.x: You could make up the rules as you went along. Listen, we're all made up rules to get out of tight spots, I'll tell you that. Yeah. I mean, impossible things. You know, they expect you to, you know, you know, you're not going to do it. I mean, the booking agents, you know, I had a booking agent, if the rehearsal would run over the, her time, which you wanted to put, I mean, the union used to allow an hour and a half, add it in with the floor show price, add it to the dance price. You see, you got paid for…
